items.title_zh: API Evangelist 的 BrainCo 公开 API 档案
bullets_zh: API Evangelist 发布了 BrainCo 公开 API 表面的第三方档案。
BrainCo 被描述为哈佛创新实验室孵化的非侵入式 BCI 硬件与 SDK 公司。
该档案有助于跟踪消费级/科研级非侵入式 BCI 开发者生态。
bullets_en: API Evangelist published a third-party profile of BrainCo's public API surface.
BrainCo is described as a Harvard innovation lab-founded non-invasive BCI hardware and SDK company.
The profile matters for tracking consumer/research non-invasive BCI developer ecosystems.
items.brief: API Evangelist 的 BrainCo API 档案，帮助跟踪非侵入式 BCI 开发者生态。
items.brief_en: API Evangelist profiles BrainCo's public API surface, helping track non-invasive BCI developer ecosystems.
items.raw_excerpt: BrainCo — independent third-party profile of a public API surface, by API Evangelist. BrainCo is a Harvard-innovation-lab-founded neurotechnology company building non-invasive brain-computer interface (BCI) hardware and the developer SDKs that surround it. Its consumer and research line centers on wearable EEG headbands - Focus, Focus1 and FocusCal

items.title_zh: AxonOS 开放脑机接口社区雷达
items.title_en: AxonOS Community Radar for Open BCI Field
bullets_zh: AxonOS Radar 是一个持续自动更新的开放脑机接口领域地图。
它是 AxonOS 社区项目，用于跟踪 BCI 软件基础设施和工具。
该资源帮助用户发现可支持非侵入式EEG/MEG/fNIRS工作的开放BCI项目。
bullets_en: AxonOS Radar is a living, auto-updated map of the open brain-computer-interface field.
It is an AxonOS community project for tracking BCI software infrastructure and tools.
The resource helps users discover open BCI projects that can support non-invasive EEG/MEG/fNIRS work.
items.brief: AxonOS社区雷达自动更新开放BCI领域地图，便于跟踪非侵入式BCI生态。
items.brief_en: AxonOS Radar is an auto-updated map of the open BCI field, useful for tracking non-invasive BCI ecosystems.
items.raw_excerpt: AxonOS Radar — a living, auto-updated map of the open brain-computer-interface field. An AxonOS community project.

items.title_zh: 基于 EEG 的 BCI Unity 游戏控制项目
items.title_en: EEG-Based BCI Unity Game Control Project
bullets_zh: 该 GitHub 项目实现了用于实时 Unity 游戏控制的 EEG 脑机接口。
它结合信号处理、CSP/LDA分类和LSL通信。
该演示可作为实用的非侵入式BCI应用管线示例。
bullets_en: This GitHub project implements an EEG-based brain-computer interface for real-time Unity game control.
It combines signal processing, CSP/LDA classification, and LSL communication.
The demo is useful as a practical non-invasive BCI application pipeline example.
items.brief: 该EEG-Unity控制项目展示实时脑控游戏管线，适合学习非侵入式BCI应用。
items.brief_en: EEG Unity control project shows a real-time brain-control game pipeline for learning non-invasive BCI apps.
items.raw_excerpt: EEG-based brain-computer interface for real-time Unity game control using signal processing, CSP/LDA classification and LSL communication.

items.title_en: ADS1299 Core SDK for Open EEG/BCI Ecosystem
bullets_zh: 该GitHub项目于2026-09-23发布，构建开放的ADS1299 EEG/BCI生态。
它面向8–64通道硬件，提供MCU、SoC、DSP和FPGA参考包。
它支持PC/移动/Linux集成以及Python/MATLAB/R的BCI工作流分析。
bullets_en: GitHub project published on 2026-09-23 builds an open ADS1299 EEG/BCI ecosystem.
It targets 8–64 channel hardware with MCU, SoC, DSP and FPGA reference packages.
It supports PC/mobile/Linux integration plus Python/MATLAB/R analysis for BCI workflows.
items.brief: 开放ADS1299 EEG硬件SDK，覆盖采集、集成与分析，适合非侵入式BCI开发。
items.brief_en: Open ADS1299 EEG hardware SDK covering acquisition, integration and analysis for non-invasive BCI development.
items.raw_excerpt: Building the world’s largest and most comprehensive open ADS1299 EEG/BCI ecosystem — 8–64CH hardware, 200 MCU/SoC/DSP & FPGA target/reference packages, Verilog RTL, PC/mobile/Linux integration, Python/MATLAB/R EEG analysis, BCI workflows, validation, education and research.

bullets_zh: 该GitHub项目于2026-09-23发布，实现实时P300脑打字拼写器。
它结合LSL流、ASR、xDAWN+LDA或黎曼MDM以及贝叶斯动态停止。
它通过SSVEP确认的LLM词补全增强非侵入式EEG通信。
bullets_en: GitHub project published on 2026-09-23 implements a real-time P300 brain-typing speller.
It combines LSL streaming, ASR, xDAWN+LDA or Riemannian MDM and Bayesian dynamic stopping.
It adds LLM word completion confirmed via SSVEP for non-invasive EEG communication.
items.brief: 实时P300拼写器结合LSL、分类与LLM补全，推进非侵入式脑打字。
items.brief_en: Real-time P300 speller combines LSL, classifiers and LLM completion to advance non-invasive brain typing.
items.raw_excerpt: Real-time P300 brain-typing speller: LSL streaming, ASR, xDAWN+LDA / Riemannian MDM, Bayesian dynamic stopping, LLM word completion confirmed via SSVEP.

items.title_zh: 用于类EEG信号仿真的生物信息学技术
items.title_en: Bioinformatics Techniques for EEG-like Signal Simulation
bullets_zh: 该GitHub课程项目于2026-09-23发布，将motif搜索应用于神经模式。
它使用生物信息学序列技术进行类EEG信号仿真。
它可作为非侵入式BCI信号分析的教育入门资源。
bullets_en: GitHub course project published on 2026-09-23 applies motif search to neural patterns.
It includes EEG-like signal simulation using bioinformatics sequence techniques.
It is useful as an educational entry point for non-invasive BCI signal analysis.
items.brief: 课程项目用motif搜索与类EEG仿真，帮助入门非侵入式神经信号分析。
items.brief_en: Course project uses motif search and EEG-like simulation to introduce non-invasive neural signal analysis.
items.raw_excerpt: Motif search + EEG-like signal simulation: bioinformatics sequence techniques applied to neural patterns (course project).

items.title_en: EEG Emotion Decoding with Gaussian HMMs
bullets_zh: 该GitHub课程项目于2026-09-23发布，从EEG解码情绪状态。
它使用ICA和约束高斯HMM，并采用OpenNeuro数据集ds003004。
Tkinter应用封装了非侵入式情绪BCI探索流程。
bullets_en: GitHub course project published on 2026-09-23 decodes emotional states from EEG.
It uses ICA and constrained Gaussian HMMs with OpenNeuro dataset ds003004.
A Tkinter app packages the workflow for non-invasive emotion BCI exploration.
items.brief: 课程项目用ICA与高斯HMM解码EEG情绪，适合非侵入式情感BCI实践。
items.brief_en: Course project uses ICA and Gaussian HMMs to decode EEG emotions for non-invasive affective BCI practice.
items.raw_excerpt: Decoding emotional states from EEG with ICA + constrained Gaussian HMMs (OpenNeuro ds003004). Tkinter app, course project.

items.title_zh: [GitHub] access-input：面向辅助访问的EEG/EMG/眼动输入抽象库
items.title_en: [GitHub] access-input: Assistive Input Abstraction for EEG/EMG/Gaze
bullets_zh: LE-VAI/access-input 是 MIT 许可的 GitHub 库，抽象了眼动、EMG 和 EEG 等辅助输入源。
它支持自适应停留和开关扫描，并对非侵入式 BCI 信号保持来源无关。
零依赖便于集成到无障碍工具和实验性 BCI 流程中。
bullets_en: LE-VAI/access-input is an MIT-licensed GitHub library that abstracts assistive input sources such as gaze, EMG, and EEG.
It supports adaptive dwell and switch scanning while remaining source-agnostic for non-invasive BCI signals.
Zero dependencies make it easy to integrate into accessibility tools and experimental BCI pipelines.
items.brief: 面向辅助访问的EEG/EMG/眼动输入抽象库，便于非侵入BCI集成。
items.brief_en: Assistive input abstraction for EEG/EMG/gaze, easing non-invasive BCI integration.
items.raw_excerpt: Input abstraction for assistive access: adaptive dwell, switch scanning, and gaze/EMG/EEG-agnostic sources. Zero dependencies, MIT.

bullets_zh: csotom2025-collab/APP_BCI_PYQUE 是一个用于构建西班牙语BCI拼写器的GitHub项目。
它包含数字0-9以及空格、回车和删除命令。
该项目展示了面向文本输入的非侵入式BCI控制实践。
bullets_en: csotom2025-collab/APP_BCI_PYQUE is a GitHub project for building a Spanish-language BCI speller.
It includes digits 0-9 and commands for space, enter, and delete.
The project demonstrates practical non-invasive BCI control for text input.
items.brief: 西班牙语BCI拼写器应用，展示非侵入式文本输入控制。
items.brief_en: Spanish BCI speller app demonstrating non-invasive text-input control.
items.raw_excerpt: Proyecto para creación de un speller con el alfabeto en español numeros del 0 -- 9 y 3 comandos Espacio(esp) ,Enter(ENT), Borrar(<--)

它反映了非侵入式BCI用户对多模态输入设备的实际兴趣。
该讨论发布于2026-09-22，可能有助于识别消费级或研究级硬件需求。
bullets_en: A Reddit r/BCI thread discusses hardware options for combining EEG with gaze tracking.
It reflects practical non-invasive BCI user interest in multimodal input devices.
The discussion is dated 2026-09-22 and may help identify consumer or research hardware needs.
